manifest.output_protocol: Return one JSON object with exactly Facts.dfy containing the COMPLETE file as a string. Change only bodies of the AppendA/AppendB lemmas that occur in this file. Preserve all definitions, headers, contracts, attributes, decreases clauses, exports and client files. Allowed statements: if comparison { statements } with optional else/else if; assert comparison; and self-recursive calls to the SAME lemma with two sequence expressions. Expressions: s, t, integers, [], Total(expression), length |expression|, indexing, slices, unary +/- and binary +/-, with arithmetic parentheses. Comparisons: < <= > >= == !=. No comments, assume, reveal, calc, declarations, loops or cross-helper calls. At most 64 statements and 2048 tokens per body; nesting 24. Automatic induction is disabled; explicit base/step reasoning may be necessary.
